descripcion: At B1 you summarise a short text or conversation in one or two sentences, naming the main idea. The finer structure with omissions and separated opinion (B2/C1) isn't the target yet — a clear, short main point is enough.

filas: The article is about the benefits of remote work.
In short, that's the main point.

ejemplos.texto: The article is mainly about the benefits of remote work.
It also mentions a few downsides, like feeling isolated.
Basically, it says people are happier working from home.

notas: The article is about… / It's mainly about… is the easiest way to open a summary.
One or two sentences are enough for a B1 summary — more starts to become a retelling.
Basically is a useful, informal way to open a compact summary.

contraste.es: El texto trata sobre… corresponds to the text is about…, so the basic structure transfers directly.
contraste.de: Der Text handelt von… corresponds to the text is about…; the calque the text handles of… is a typical error.
contraste.it: Il testo parla di… is often calqued as the text speaks of…; the natural English form is the text is about….
contraste.fr: Le texte parle de… is often calqued as the text speaks about…; the natural English form is the text is about….
contraste.pt: O texto fala de… is often calqued as the text speaks about…; the natural English form is the text is about….

errores: Retelling the whole text instead of summarising it.
Giving too many details instead of just the main idea.
Not stating a clear main idea at all.
autochequeo: Is the main idea clearly stated?
Is the summary much shorter than the original?
Have I given no more than one extra detail?
Have I used more than one summarising phrase?
Does it sound like a summary, not a retelling?
promptCorreccion: Focus only on whether the main idea is clear and the summary stays compact, without retelling the whole original text in detail. Do not rewrite the text.
